description_en: Applies the clustering suggestions for a specified analysis batch. Only partitioned tables are supported. Before calling this operation, you can call GetAutoClusterSuggestion to view the recommended configurations and table modification SQL statements. This operation returns a response after the table modification is successfully executed
description_zh: 应用指定分析批次的聚簇建议。仅支持分区表。调用前可用 GetAutoClusterSuggestion 查看推荐配置和表变更 SQL。接口在表变更执行成功后返回
kebab_example: aliyun maxcompute apply-auto-cluster --project analytics_prod --table order_detail --date 20251123 --api-version 2022-01-04 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ApplyAutoCluster
